subject: Vanguard: SIG/CAIQ evidence - tenant log retention and deletion exception process
messages:
From: Matthew Nguyen <matthew.nguyen@vanguard.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.lewis@vanguard.com
Date: 2027-04-04T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ evidence request - tenant log retention and deletion exception process

Hi Avery,

We're working through Vanguard's SIG/CAIQ review for our platform integrations. A few specific items came up from InfoSec around customer-scoped logs and deletion workflows that I hope Redwood can help evidence: 

- Confirmation of your standard tenant log retention policy (default TTLs for session logs, API request logs, and KV cache traces).
- Process and evidence for customer-specific retention exceptions / waivers (how those are approved and recorded).
- Sample audit trail for a tenant deletion or targeted log disposal request (showing request, authorization, and final deletion event).
- Any compensating controls you apply when logs are not fully persisted (e.g., hash audit logs, SIEM forwarding, escrow).

Can you point me to documentation we can include in our SIG/CAIQ pack, and a small sample (redacted) audit CSV or similar that shows the lifecycle for one deletion request? If you need a short call to align, I can set one up this week.

Thanks,
Matt
Matthew Nguyen
Information Security Engineer
Vanguard
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Matthew Nguyen <matthew.nguyen@vanguard.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-04T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ evidence request - tenant log retention and deletion exception process

Matt —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the docs and a redacted audit sample. I'll loop in Karthik (security/compliance) and Marissa (solutions) to gather the artifacts. High level answers in the meantime: 

- Default TTLs: session logs 7 days, request/trace logs 30 days, KV cache traces ephemeral (24–48 hours) unless customer opts into extended retention.
- Exceptions: Customer-specific retention waivers are approved by Security + Sales via a documented exception request (stored in our compliance tracker) and require an SLA amendment for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Audit trail: We can produce a CSV with request ID, requester, approver, timestamp, deletion job id, and final status; we will redact tenant IDs before sharing.
- Compensating controls: When we reduce retention for performance or cost reasons, we persist a hash-based audit log stored in immutable object storage (WORM) and forward critical events to a centralized SIEM for 90 days.

Karthik / Marissa — can you pull the retention matrix, an excerpt from our forensics playbook, and a redacted deletion-audit sample? Preferably delivered as PDFs/CSV. Matt — would you prefer the materials uploaded to a shared Drive or attached directly to email?

Best,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-04T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ evidence request - tenant log retention and deletion exception process

Avery —

Adding detail for the artifacts we'll provide. Inline answers and items to include in the package: 

> Default TTLs: session logs 7 days, request/trace logs 30 days, KV cache traces ephemeral (24–48 hours) unless customer opts into extended retention.

- Confirmed. I'll export the retention_matrix_v1.pdf (matrix by log type, environment, and plan).
- Exceptions workflow: we store exception requests as a ticket in our compliance tracker (internal doc ID), require Security + Sales approval, and if customer signs an SLA amendment we mark the tenant as "extended-retention" in our config service. We'll include a redacted workflow diagram and the approval checklist.
- Audit trail sample: we'll generate tenant_deletion_audit_sample.csv with columns: request_id, requestor_email, request_timestamp, approver_email, approval_timestamp, deletion_job_id, deletion_start, deletion_complete, deletion_status, notes. The sample will have PII and tenant identifiers redacted.
- Compensating controls: excerpt from forensics_handbook_excerpt.pdf will describe WORM storage for hashes, SIEM forwarding (Elastic stack retention), and snapshot escrow options for Dedicated customers.

Action items for me: build the CSV (redact tenant), grab matrix PDF, extract handbook excerpt that is not privileged. Deliver artifacts by EOD tomorrow. Also recommend offering Vanguard a short preserve window (canary preserve) where we can hold logs for 14 days under a signed request while they validate deletion procedures.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Matthew Nguyen <matthew.nguyen@vanguard.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sarah.lewis@vanguard.com
Date: 2027-04-05T14:39:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ evidence request - tenant log retention and deletion exception process

Matt / Sarah —

Attached are the items Karthik assembled for your SIG/CAIQ pack: 

Attachments: 
- retention_matrix_v1.pdf (log type x plan matrix; shows default TTLs and extended-retention flags)
- forensics_handbook_excerpt.pdf (non-sensitive excerpt describing WORM hash storage and SIEM forwarding)
- tenant_deletion_audit_sample.csv (redacted sample showing lifecycle for a deletion request)

Hosted copies: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cVanguardEvidence (view only). HubSpot reference: HS-123456.

A few clarifications: 
- Standard offering: request/trace logs are kept 30 days by default for Hosted accounts. For Dedicated and Private customers we can negotiate longer retention and document it in the SLA.
- Exception approvals: the compliance tracker entry includes the exception rationale, approvers (Security + Sales), and change to tenant config. We'll include a redacted approval checklist in the drive folder.
- Audit sample: the CSV demonstrates the request flow from creation through deletion_complete. We replace tenant identifiers with a stable pseudonym; the deletion_job_id is present so you can confirm traceability.

If Vanguard would like, we can stand up a 14-day canary preserve for a pilot tenant so your team can validate deletion observability before sign-off. Let me know if you'd like us to schedule a 30–45 minute technical review with Karthik and Marissa.

Best regards,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0189

Avery —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. We'll review the PDFs and the CSV this afternoon. The canary preserve offer sounds useful — Sarah and I will discuss and follow up with preferred dates. Appreciate the clear audit fields; that should map cleanly into our SIG evidence sheet.

Best,
Matt
